info.name: ES Microservice Platform - Complete API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the ES (EventSphere) Microservice Platform.

All routes go through the API Gateway at http://localhost:6970/api/v1

## Quick Start Flow
1. Run 'Register Users' folder — registers all 6 role users
2. IMPORTANT: Manually set the admin user's role to ADMIN in the database (or via bootstrap)
3. Run 'Login' folder — all tokens auto-saved to collection variables
4. Run 'Change Roles' requests (requires adminToken) to promote each user
5. Now all tokens work for their respective role-restricted endpoints

## Auto-saved Variables
Tokens are saved automatically after each login.
Resource IDs are saved after each create operation.

## Note on Vendor & Venue Manager URLs
Vendor and Venue manager controllers use '/api/v1/...' prefix internally.
Gateway strips 3 segments, so URLs look like:
  {{baseUrl}}/vendor-manager/api/v1/vendors  (not /vendor-manager/vendors)
  {{baseUrl}}/venue-manager/api/v1/venues

item.name: Register Users
item.description: Register one user per role. All start as ATTENDEE by default — use Change Roles after logging in as admin.
